declared_at_utc: see commit (8 October 2026, before its governing run)
declared_by: Declaring and the governing run are research; a build under runs/submissions and any upload stay the user's word.
status: DECLARED before its governing run. The five-seed bags have not been fitted or read.
disclosure: NOT A CLEAN TEST. A 'what's left' audit on v71's development residuals (8 October, exploration; runs/audit_v71/audit_results.json, scratch scripts aud_build / aud_fit / aud_fit2) fitted a month-blocked single-seed LightGBM (the settings below, seed 7) on several input groups. All airports: Jan -0.014 / Jul -0.008 / Nov -0.147 / Dec -0.192%, with LIRF worsening January and July (+5.4e6 / +14.1e6 s²) and LFPG / LTFM mixed. The airport sets below were chosen AFTER reading that per-airport table; single-seed readings: no-LIRF, trained in-set, eq -0.0914% (every interval below zero); the seven high-coverage airports, trained in-set, eq -0.1171% (every interval below zero); stacker-only inputs -0.082 / -0.105%. Rationale beyond the reading: LIRF runs its own stacker learner (v2) and the fill-population hedges; LFPG (9% of 2025 rows ADS-B-matched) and LTFM (0%) carry little of the ADS-B-derived inputs. No fresh-month check is possible: the stacker's inputs exist only for the four development months. The stacker-weight round (docs/stack_weight/README.md) had already shown that more stacker weight helps November / December and hurts January / July overall.
mechanism: A second guarded residual pass on top of v71: v70's stacker applies 0.65 of its out-of-month prediction and the neighbour layers come after it; a further LightGBM on the same label-free inputs (plus the neighbour, queue and clock columns) learns the remaining systematic error at the high-coverage airports.

inputs.stacker: the 79 columns of tools/run_stack_weight.dev_inputs / rank_inputs (OPDI learner's matrix X79 / X79r), prefixed 's_', a repeated name suffixed with its position
inputs.neighbour: nx, nxk, nn (tools/nbr_columns.columns with value = v70: development the v70 development proxy, ranking the uploaded v70) and x_nmerr = tools/run_nbr_state.state on value = v70 and v9 replaced by take-off - AOBT_3, neighbours = matched rows with take-off - AOBT_3 in [-3600, 7200] s
inputs.queue: gp, gn, gp2, gp4, gn4, bpos, blen (tools/run_stack_queue.queue_dev / queue_rank)
inputs.clocks: take-off minus SCHED_TIME / AOBT_3 / LOBT / EOBT_1 / IOBT, ARVT_3 minus take-off, hour of day (fractional), day of week, and v71 - v70 (the neighbour layers' change)
inputs.class: kind (0 unmatched, 1 dark = matched not gate-traced, 2 gate-traced, 3 fixed) and ap (airport code, categorical)

procedure.target: clip(label - v71, -1800, 1800); v71 = the control's development values (v70 development proxy + nbr_state_v1 w75 + nbr_dark_v1, rebuilt and checked against docs/nbr_state/dark_results_v1.json's RMSEs).
procedure.model: LightGBM regression, learning_rate 0.03, num_leaves 31, min_data_in_leaf 800, lambda_l2 50, feature_fraction 0.7, bagging_fraction 0.7, bagging_freq 1, max_bin 127, 400 rounds, deterministic, force_col_wise, 16 threads; categorical kind, ap; five seeds 7, 11, 12, 13, 14, predictions averaged.
procedure.fit_rows: non-fixed rows of the candidate's airports.
procedure.development: each development month predicted by bags fitted on the other three months.
procedure.ranking: bags fitted on all four development months, applied to the ranking rows of the candidate's airports.
procedure.value: new = max(v71 + clip(0.5 x bag, -120, 120), -12) on non-fixed rows of the candidate's airports; every other row keeps v71. Ranking: np.rint into the file's dtype from the uploaded v71 (2dfb3b9f...); every other row byte-identical.

rule.clause_1: No development month (January, July, November, December 2025) worse than the control by more than 0.005% of complete-month RMSE.
rule.clause_2: Equal-footing mean (January, July, December) at most -0.02%.
rule.clause_3: Paired-day 95% interval below zero for January, July and December (tools/run_intruder_bound.interval, 2,000 replicates, seed 20261004).
rule.clause_4_transfer: Per airport, RMS of the ranking change (both months pooled, moved rows) within 0.5x-2x of the RMS of the out-of-month development change; an airport outside keeps v71 on every row (the dry run is built that way). If more than two of the candidate's airports fall outside, the candidate is not accepted.
rule.selection: Among candidates passing clauses 1-4, the lowest clause-2 mean; none -> v71 stays.
rule.scoring: Every row of every complete month, all labels.

compute: Tables built locally (light pandas, seconds); the LightGBM fits on Azure arcw0, deallocated after the hash-checked copy back.
